correctness.rationale: Use Baruah--Gogoi F=(T^-1-T^3)/8 and theta T=1+2A with A=sum_{j>=1} (-1)^j q^{j^2}. Integral expansion modulo 4 yields -A-A^2-2A^3+2A^4; Gaussian norm r_2=4sum chi_-4 and x^2+2y^2 norm r=2sum chi_-8, with explicit removal of axis solutions, recover all four terms including even n and square corrections. For odd squarefree composite n the two divisor products have >=2 factors of 0 or 2 and vanish mod4; primes give residues by classes mod8. Independent overpartition weighted-product and arithmetic checks through n=160 and source verifier through n=420 support transcription only. No divisor quantifier is inferred from finite tests.
